column2: Full-tuition, room, board, fees, and textbooks (does not cover incoming deposits or fees)

Must be a first-time, full-time domestic freshman. International applicants are not eligible. Have a minimum 3.5 cumulative high school GPA on a 4.0 scale, a 25 or greater on the ACT (or SAT score of 1200), or be eligible to graduate as the valedictorian or salutatorian of your high school class. Prospective scholars must apply and submit all documents (official transcript(s), ACT/SAT scores, and letter of recommendation) by December 1. Must be enrolled full-time (12-18 credit hours) at HSSU to receive the scholarship.

Recipients must complete a minimum of 30 credit hours annually at HSSU, between the fall and spring semesters, and maintain a 3.5 or greater cumulative GPA. The Presidential Scholarship is renewable for up to eight (8) semesters or completing an undergraduate degree.
